verdict.rationale: The evidence shows FreeAgent has an OAuth-authenticated API with a sandbox and endpoints for invoices and bank transactions. Nothing in the pack documents creating or posting journal entries through the API, or a draft or review-queue state an accountant could approve. Generic API access is only a building block, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent draft and post journal entries via the API and leave them in a review queue for my accountant
